decisions.reason: Glass-silicon wafers with through contacts are core to the firm's wafer-level packaging competence and fit its direction toward multifunctional packaging wafers.
Carrier wafers for thin and small-diameter wafer handling match the stated strategic focus on reusable carriers and need little extra resource to maintain.
The Cu-interposer glass wafer is a flagship technology aligned with advanced packaging trends, and the semiconductor market was booming in 2021-2022.
The Wafer Universe off-the-shelf brand is a low-cost extension of the standard catalog and serves as a sales channel close to the established business.

Glass-based circuit boards are distant from the core and riskier, but they are technologically related to the interposer and through-via know-how, so a small, R&D-driven firm would likely keep them on offer for now.
